declarations.name: LuzTimeline
declarations.description: A rail of dates, Previous / Next and opt-in autoplay around an ordered list.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: Every item stays visible down a line; the item in the middle of the screen is active.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Opt in to moving on by itself, with a visible Pause and Play.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-previous
attributes.description: The text of the Previous button, on the element or an ancestor; the language's own by default.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-next
attributes.description: The text of the Next button, on the element or an ancestor; the language's own by default.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-pause
attributes.description: The text of the Pause button of autoplay, on the element or an ancestor; the language's own by default.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-play
attributes.description: The text of the Play button of autoplay, on the element or an ancestor; the language's own by default.
